description: Overtemperature alarm triggered — hotspot >115°C sustained for 4h. Immediate load reduction and thermal inspection required.
Buchholz relay gas alarm. DGA sample taken — hydrogen 320ppm (threshold 100ppm). PDC testing scheduled.
Tap changer contact inspection — excessive arcing marks observed at positions 7-9. Contacts cleaned and tested.
Annual oil sampling and DGA per IEC 60567. Results borderline — follow-up in 6 months.
OTI alarm sustained — winding temp indicator showing 110°C. Load shed 15% and monitoring deployed.
Main tank oil leak from drain valve. Valve replaced, oil topped up to operating level, leak test passed.
Bushing flashover at HV terminal under rain conditions. Asset isolated. Bushing replacement in progress.
Thermographic inspection — hot spot identified on LV bushing connection. Retorquing and thermal re-check completed.
